ENABLE.NAME: Presence simulation
ENABLE.DESCRIPTION: 1 = nobody is home: the block switches the lights on and off by itself inside the time window

MODE.NAME: Presence simulation mode
MODE.DESCRIPTION: Off: not used in the presence simulation. Random: min..max activations of min..max minutes. Replay: repeats what was switched by hand one week ago (random when nothing was recorded)

WINDOW.NAME: Presence simulation time window
WINDOW.DESCRIPTION: Start, end and days of the simulation (default 18:00-23:00)

LIGHTING_CONTROLLER.NAME: Lighting controller
LIGHTING_CONTROLLER.DESCRIPTION: Up to 8 circuits of a room with moods, motion, brightness threshold and presence simulation

MOOD_PLUS.NAME: Mood +
MOOD_PLUS.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: next mood (user moods, then all on)

MOOD_SELECT.NAME: Mood
MOOD_SELECT.DESCRIPTION: Mood number: 0 off, 1-89 user moods, 99 all on

MOTION.NAME: Motion
MOTION.DESCRIPTION: 1 switches the motion mood on when it is dark, 0 starts the overrun

BRIGHTNESS.NAME: Brightness [lx]
BRIGHTNESS.DESCRIPTION: Motion only switches on below the brightness threshold

COMMAND.NAME: Command
COMMAND.DESCRIPTION: Text commands of the visualization: mood:N, next, prev, on, off, set:circuit:value, save:new|N:name, rename:N:name, delete:N

CIRCUIT.DESCRIPTION: Value of the circuit: true/false (switch), 0-100 (dimmer, tunable white) or #RRGGBB (RGB)

KELVIN.DESCRIPTION: Colour temperature of a tunable white circuit

MOOD.NAME: Active mood
MOOD.DESCRIPTION: 0 off, 99 all on, -1 changed by hand, 1-89 user mood

CIRCUIT_TYPE.DESCRIPTION: What is connected to the circuit output

MOODS.NAME: Moods
MOODS.DESCRIPTION: Initial moods, e.g. Reading:1=100,2=on;Cosy:1=30,3=#FF8800,4=40@2700 - once a mood is saved in the visualization the saved moods are used

MOTION_MOOD.NAME: Motion mood
MOTION_MOOD.DESCRIPTION: Mood switched on by motion and the presence simulation (99 = all on)

MOTION_OFF_DELAY.NAME: Motion overrun [s]
MOTION_OFF_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Off this long after the motion ends (0 = never)

MANUAL_OFF_DELAY.NAME: Overrun after manual use [s]
MANUAL_OFF_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Used instead when the lights were operated by hand (0 = never off)

AUTOMATIC_TIMEOUT.NAME: Motion pause after off [s]
AUTOMATIC_TIMEOUT.DESCRIPTION: After switching off by hand motion is ignored until there was no motion for this long (0 = never ignored)

BRIGHTNESS_THRESHOLD.NAME: Brightness threshold [lx]
BRIGHTNESS_THRESHOLD.DESCRIPTION: Motion switches on only below it (0 = always)

STAIRWELL_LIGHT_SWITCH.NAME: Stairwell light switch
STAIRWELL_LIGHT_SWITCH.DESCRIPTION: On for a time with every trigger, with switch-off warning

TRIGGER.NAME: Trigger
TRIGGER.DESCRIPTION: 1 = on for the on duration (restarts the time)

WARNING_TIME.NAME: Switch-off warning [s]
WARNING_TIME.DESCRIPTION: This long before the end the light blinks off once (0 = no warning)

WARNING_DURATION.NAME: Warning blink [ms]
WARNING_DURATION.DESCRIPTION: How long the light is off for the warning

COMFORT_SWITCH.NAME: Comfort switch
COMFORT_SWITCH.DESCRIPTION: Short press: on for a time / off, long press: permanently on, with switch-off warning

TRIGGER.NAME: Button
TRIGGER.DESCRIPTION: Push button: short press toggles, long press = permanently on

WARNING_TIME.NAME: Switch-off warning [s]
WARNING_TIME.DESCRIPTION: This long before the end the light blinks off once (0 = no warning)

WARNING_DURATION.NAME: Warning blink [ms]
WARNING_DURATION.DESCRIPTION: How long the light is off for the warning

RGB_LIGHTING_CONTROLLER.NAME: RGB lighting controller
RGB_LIGHTING_CONTROLLER.DESCRIPTION: Colour scenes with +/-, scene number or a direct colour

COLOR.NAME: Colour
COLOR.DESCRIPTION: #RRGGBB, r,g,b in % or the Loxone value (B·1000000 + G·1000 + R)

SCENES.NAME: Scenes
SCENES.DESCRIPTION: Colours separated by ; (#RRGGBB or r,g,b in %), scene 1 is the first

CONSTANT_BRIGHTNESS.NAME: Constant brightness controller
CONSTANT_BRIGHTNESS.DESCRIPTION: Keeps the room brightness at a target by dimming in steps

OFF.NAME: Off
OFF.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: off, the control stops until Active rises again

HYSTERESIS.NAME: Hysteresis [%]
HYSTERESIS.DESCRIPTION: Of the target, inside it nothing changes

ACTIVE.DESCRIPTION: Link the 'Light on' output of a lighting controller (not needed for lights picked in 'Lights')

MOOD_PLUS.NAME: Mood +
MOOD_PLUS.DESCRIPTION: Link to the same input of every lighting controller

MOOD_MINUS.NAME: Mood -
MOOD_MINUS.DESCRIPTION: Link to the same input of every lighting controller

MOOD.NAME: Mood
MOOD.DESCRIPTION: Link to the same input of every lighting controller

OFF.NAME: Off
OFF.DESCRIPTION: Link to the same input of every lighting controller

ON.NAME: On
ON.DESCRIPTION: Link to the same input of every lighting controller

DISABLE_MOTION.NAME: Disable motion
DISABLE_MOTION.DESCRIPTION: Link to the same input of every lighting controller

LIGHTS.NAME: Lights
LIGHTS.DESCRIPTION: Pick the lighting controllers, switches and dimmers instead of linking them: they get on, off, moods and +/- directly and are counted. Pick or link a controller, not both.

HOTEL_LIGHTING_CONTROLLER.NAME: Hotel lighting controller
HOTEL_LIGHTING_CONTROLLER.DESCRIPTION: Lighting controller with key card, room state, door contact and cleaning service

ROOM_STATUS.NAME: Room status
ROOM_STATUS.DESCRIPTION: 1 vacant/not cleaned, 2 occupied/not cleaned, 3 vacant/cleaned, 4 occupied/cleaned

LEAVE_TIMEOUT.NAME: Leave timeout [s]
LEAVE_TIMEOUT.DESCRIPTION: Off this long after the card was removed (0 = never)
